question: Spot the correct spelling of a term meaning 'theory of knowledge'.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term "Epistemology" refers to the branch of philosophy concerned with the theory of knowledge.
 
• The correct spelling is **Epistemology**, which is derived from the Greek words "episteme" (knowledge) and "logos" (study or discourse).
